• Stanley Kubrick had Shelley Duvall perform the baseball bat scene 127 times, a Guinness record for most retakes of a single scene with spoken dialogue. 234 of 256 found this interesting.
  • The blood that pours out of the elevators required 10,000 gallons of fake blood and took a full year to film across multiple takes.
  • Jack Nicholson improvised the "Heeeeere's Johnny!" line, which Kubrick almost cut because he wasn't familiar with The Tonight Show.
